id.question: Bagaimana Prosedur untuk penyesuaian CV menjadi PT?
id.answer: Menyelesaikan perikatan CV dengan pihak ketiga; Menyesuaikan Anggaran Dasar CV karena pada Anggaran Dasar CV tidak ada ketentuan mengenai Modal Dasar, Modal Ditempatkan, dan Modal Disetor, sedangkan untuk menjadi PT harus memenuhi ketentuan Modal Dasar PT (lihat Pasal 7 ayat [2] UUPT); Membuat Akta pendirian (akta notaris) yang memuat Anggaran Dasar dan keterangan lain berkaitan dengan pendirian PT (lihat Pasal 7 ayat [1] jo. Pasal 8 ayat [1] UUPT); Para pendiri bersama-sama mengajukan permohonan pengesahan badan hukum melalui AHU Online (lihat Pasal 1 angka 16 jo. Pasal 9 ayat [1] UUPT); Pengumuman di Tambahan Berita Negara RI. Jika para pendiri hendak mengikutsertakan perbuatan hukum yang terjadi saat masih berbentuk CV ke dalam PT, RUPS pertama harus secara tegas menyatakan menerima/mengambil alih hak dan kewajiban tersebut (lihat Pasal 13 ayat [1] UUPT).

id.question: Berapa Besaran Modal untuk mendirikan PT baik Modal Dasar maupun Modal ditempatkan disetor?
id.answer: Berdasarkan PP Nomor 8 Tahun 2021 Pasal 3, untuk usaha mikro dan kecil, besaran modal dasar perseroan ditentukan berdasarkan keputusan pendiri perseroan. Berdasarkan Pasal 4, modal dasar tersebut harus ditempatkan dan disetor penuh paling sedikit 25%, dibuktikan dengan bukti penyetoran, dan wajib disampaikan secara elektronik kepada Menteri dalam waktu paling lama 60 hari sejak tanggal akta pendirian perseroan.

id.question: Syarat menjadi pemegang Saham PT?
id.answer: Orang pribadi atau badan hukum yang cakap melakukan perbuatan hukum, memiliki NPWP, dan berstatus Warga Negara Indonesia (WNI).

id.question: Apakah Warga Negara Asing atau badan hukum asing bisa menjadi Pemegang Saham PT Indonesia?
id.answer: Bisa. Kepemilikan asing mengakibatkan perseroan berstatus PT PMA dan wajib mengikuti ketentuan penanaman modal asing.

id.question: Bagaimana Prosedur perubahan maksud dan tujuan pada PT?
id.answer: Dilakukan melalui RUPS, dituangkan dalam akta notaris, kemudian diajukan sebagai perubahan anggaran dasar melalui AHU Online untuk memperoleh persetujuan Menteri.

id.question: Apa yang harus dilakukan jika salah satu pemegang Saham PT di Indonesia adalah badan hukum luar negeri dan sudah melakukan pembubaran tanpa sepengetahuan PT tersebut?
id.answer: PT perlu menelusuri status hukum pemegang saham tersebut, lalu mengadakan perubahan pemegang saham dengan menghadirkan perwakilan badan hukum luar negeri tersebut untuk mengalihkan sahamnya ke badan hukum lain atau perorangan.

id.question: Apakah perbedaan akuisisi dan peralihan saham serta merger?
id.answer: Merger (Pasal 1 ayat [9] UUPT) adalah penggabungan satu Perseroan atau lebih ke Perseroan lain yang sudah ada, sehingga aktiva dan pasiva Perseroan yang menggabungkan diri beralih karena hukum dan status badan hukumnya berakhir. Akuisisi (Pasal 1 ayat [11] UUPT) adalah pengambilalihan saham Perseroan yang mengakibatkan beralihnya pengendalian, namun badan hukum Perseroan yang diambil alih tidak berakhir. Pada Merger, hanya perusahaan pengambil alih yang tetap eksis; pada Akuisisi, kedua perusahaan tetap eksis.

id.question: Apa saja prosedur dan persyaratan pembubaran PT Tahap II?
id.answer: Surat hasil likuidasi Perseroan dari likuidator kepada Kementerian Hukum dan HAM c.q. Direktur Perdata Ditjen AHU beserta rincian pembagian harta kekayaan Perseroan/Neraca; Salinan Akta Notaris berakhirnya status badan hukum dan pemberitahuan pembebasan/pelunasan tanggung jawab likuidator; Asli pengumuman di surat kabar mengenai hasil akhir proses likuidasi (Pasal 152 ayat [3] UU No. 40 Tahun 2007); Asli bukti PNBP pengumuman dalam BNRI sebesar Rp30.000 yang disetor ke rekening Perum Percetakan Negara RI; Surat Permohonan Notaris yang dikirim manual (via pos) ke Ditjen AHU, subdit Badan Hukum (PT).

id.question: Apa sajakah Langkah selanjutnya setelah suatu PT melakukan pembubaran?
id.answer: Langkah selanjutnya adalah berakhirnya status badan hukum Perseroan dan mengumumkan berakhirnya status tersebut dalam Berita Negara Republik Indonesia, agar PT tersebut bebas dari kewajiban pajak.

id.question: Bagaimana tata cara mengajukan permohonan pembubaran PT yang telah bubar dikarenakan Pailit Harta atau insolven berdasarkan Putusan Pengadilan Niaga?
id.answer: Diatur dalam Permenkumham No. 1 Tahun 2016 tentang perubahan Permenkumham No. 4 Tahun 2014. Permohonan pembubaran disampaikan Notaris secara elektronik melalui SABH (AHU Online). Setelah Penetapan Pengadilan Negeri, likuidator menghubungi Notaris untuk Akta Pembubaran, lalu wajib mengumumkan ke media cetak. Dalam 30 hari, bukti pengumuman koran dan Surat Pemberitahuan online (terbit 2 bulan setelah pengumuman) beserta bukti PNBP Rp30.000 dilampirkan. Setelah 60 hari, likuidator melakukan pemberesan dan meminta Notaris membuat Akta Pemberesan. Ada 2 tahap: (1) melalui AHU Online — membuat akta pembubaran, akses sistem online, jangka waktu 30 hari, tunggu 60 hari untuk mencetak Surat Penerimaan Pemberitahuan Pembubaran; (2) oleh Likuidator/Notaris secara manual — pemberesan kekayaan (appraisal), pengumuman pemberesan di surat kabar, Akta Pemberesan ke Notaris, dan pelaporan hasil akhir ke Kemenkumham secara manual, diikuti pengumuman berakhirnya status badan hukum Perseroan.

id.question: Bagaimana prosedur permohonan perbaikan data PT yang salah?
id.answer: Diajukan oleh Notaris melalui AHU Online dengan melampirkan dokumen pendukung yang membuktikan adanya kesalahan data. Perbaikan data perseroan dapat dilakukan dengan 2 cara: (1) sistem online, jika SK/SP belum lebih dari 90 hari dari terbitnya — jenis perbaikan yang bisa dilakukan online meliputi NIK/paspor, NPWP, dan jabatan jika sudah sesuai akta; (2) sistem manual, jika sudah lebih dari 90 hari dari terbitnya SK/SP, dengan persyaratan: surat permohonan perbaikan isian database ke Ditjen AHU U.P. Direktorat Perdata c.q. Subdit Badan Hukum Kemenkumham RI (Jl. HR. Rasuna Said Kav. 6-7, Kuningan, Jakarta Selatan 12940), surat pernyataan bermaterai dari Notaris, dan data pendukung seperti fotokopi KTP/NPWP/paspor, fotokopi akta legalisir (jika perbaikan modal), fotokopi SK/SP perubahan terakhir, serta PNBP perbaikan isian data.

id.question: Apa saja data Perseroan yang dapat diperbaiki?
id.answer: Data administratif akibat kesalahan input/penulisan yang didukung dokumen sah, meliputi: data pribadi Susunan Pemegang Saham maupun Pengurus Perseroan (tempat kelahiran, negara asal, nomor paspor/NIK, tanggal lahir, alamat, NPWP, jabatan, dan nilai nominal saham); Modal Dasar dan Modal Ditempatkan/Disetor; domisili/alamat lengkap Perseroan; alamat email dan nomor telepon Pengurus dan Pemegang Saham; serta nomor dan tanggal akta.

id.question: Apa itu proses verifikasi substantif?
id.answer: Pemeriksaan oleh petugas AHU terhadap kesesuaian dokumen dan substansi permohonan dengan ketentuan hukum yang berlaku, meliputi permohonan perubahan data Perseroan, perubahan susunan Direktur dan Komisaris, serta peralihan saham.

id.question: Berapa lama proses Verifikasi Substantif?
id.answer: Bergantung pada kompleksitas dan kelengkapan dokumen serta antrean permohonan yang sedang diproses AHU. Sebagaimana pengumuman resmi di media sosial AHU, proses Verifikasi Substantif membutuhkan waktu kurang lebih 14 hari kerja.

id.question: Bagaimana prosedur pemenuhan Kewajiban Laporan Tahunan PT?
id.answer: Laporan tahunan disusun oleh direksi, ditelaah komisaris, disahkan dalam RUPS, dan dibuat dalam Akta Notaris maksimal 6 bulan setelah tahun buku yang baru lampau ditutup, kemudian dilaporkan kepada Menteri paling lambat 30 hari setelah RUPS diaktakan.

id.question: Apakah CV diwajibkan melakukan laporan tahunan seperti PT?
id.answer: Tidak. Tidak terdapat kewajiban laporan tahunan kepada AHU sebagaimana yang berlaku pada Perseroan Terbatas.

id.question: Bagaimana prosedur pelaporan Beneficial Owner (BO)?
id.answer: Dapat dilakukan saat pendirian badan usaha melalui aplikasi Pemilik Manfaat Korporasi (BO) secara terpisah oleh Notaris yang membuat dan melaporkan Akta Pendirian Perseroan.

id.question: Apakah perbedaan dari Pengkinian dan Perubahan Pemilik Manfaat?
id.answer: Perubahan dan Pengkinian hanya bisa dilakukan jika sudah ada pelaporan sebelumnya. Pada fitur Perubahan, data dapat ditambah dan dihapus. Pada fitur Pengkinian, data dapat diperbarui/diedit. Semua data dapat diubah kecuali nama, tempat, dan tanggal lahir pemilik manfaat — jika ada kesalahan pada data tersebut, pemohon harus memilih transaksi Perubahan.

id.question: Apa sajakah kriteria Pemilik Manfaat Perseroan?
id.answer: Pemilik Manfaat dari perseroan terbatas adalah orang perseorangan yang memenuhi salah satu kriteria: memiliki saham lebih dari 25%; memiliki hak suara lebih dari 25%; menerima keuntungan/laba lebih dari 25% per tahun; memiliki kewenangan mengangkat, menggantikan, atau memberhentikan anggota direksi/komisaris; memiliki kewenangan mengendalikan perseroan tanpa otorisasi pihak lain; menerima manfaat dari perseroan; dan/atau merupakan pemilik sebenarnya dari dana atas kepemilikan saham perseroan.

id.question: Dokumen apa sajakah yang dapat di apostille?
id.answer: Tidak semua dokumen wajib diapostille; tergantung kebutuhan negara tujuan. Dokumen yang dapat diapostille meliputi Akta Kelahiran, Ijazah, Dokumen Pernikahan (Akta/Buku Nikah), dan Dokumen Perusahaan.

id.question: Apakah Sertifikat apostille memiliki jangka waktu (kadaluwarsa)?
id.answer: Sertifikat Apostille pada prinsipnya tidak memiliki masa berlaku tersendiri, namun dokumen yang dilekatinya dapat memiliki masa berlaku sesuai ketentuan masing-masing dokumen (contoh: Surat Keterangan Catatan Kepolisian).

id.question: Apa perbedaan Perseroan Perorangan dengan Perseroan Terbatas dan Perseroan Komanditer (CV)?
id.answer: Perseroan Perorangan didirikan oleh satu orang untuk usaha mikro dan kecil. PT didirikan oleh dua orang atau lebih sebagai persekutuan modal. CV bukan badan hukum dan terdiri dari sekutu aktif serta pasif.

id.question: Dokumen apa saja yang dapat dijadikan jaminan fidusia?
id.answer: Benda bergerak berwujud maupun tidak berwujud, piutang, persediaan, kendaraan, mesin, dan aset lain yang memenuhi syarat objek fidusia.

id.question: Apa saja persyaratan pendaftaran wasiat?
id.answer: Dilakukan oleh Notaris dengan menyampaikan data dan dokumen wasiat sesuai ketentuan yang berlaku melalui sistem AHU.

id.question: Apa saja syarat dan bagaimana prosedur penghapusan wasiat?
id.answer: Diajukan oleh Notaris berdasarkan akta pencabutan atau dokumen yang menjadi dasar penghapusan, kemudian dilaporkan melalui AHU.

id.question: Bagaimana persyaratan pendirian Yayasan yang didirikan sebelum Undang-Undang Yayasan?
id.answer: Terhadap Yayasan yang lahir sebelum Undang-Undang dan tidak memenuhi ketentuan Pasal 71 Undang-Undang, Yayasan tersebut harus melakukan pengesahan pendirian dengan menyebutkan sejarahnya dalam premis sesuai Pasal 15a PP No. 2 Tahun 2013, dengan terlebih dahulu melakukan pemesanan nama.

id.question: Apa yang terjadi jika Susunan Yayasan memiliki kekosongan pada Organ Pengurus?
id.answer: Pembina harus segera mengangkat pengurus baru sesuai mekanisme yang diatur dalam anggaran dasar Yayasan.

id.question: Hal-hal apa saja yang mendasari diperlukannya penutupan/pembubaran Yayasan?
id.answer: Karena tujuan Yayasan telah tercapai atau tidak tercapai, jangka waktu berakhir, adanya putusan pengadilan, atau alasan lain sesuai undang-undang.

id.question: Bagaimana cara mendaftarkan CV yang berdiri sebelum Undang-Undang namun belum didaftarkan di pengadilan?
id.answer: Berdasarkan Permenkumham No. 17 Tahun 2018 tentang Pendaftaran Persekutuan Komanditer, Persekutuan Firma, dan Persekutuan Perdata, pendaftaran CV harus melalui Notaris dengan mengakses SABU pada AHU Online. Persyaratan umum: pendiri minimal 2 orang (Sekutu Aktif dan Pasif); akta notaris dalam Bahasa Indonesia; pendiri CV harus WNI. Pemohon membuat akta baru dengan premis yang menyebutkan akta pendirian yang sudah ada, kemudian mendaftarkannya ke Ditjen AHU.

id.question: Apakah perlu menggunakan pengumuman koran pada saat melakukan pembubaran CV?
id.answer: Tidak terdapat kewajiban umum pengumuman koran sebagaimana pembubaran PT, kecuali dipersyaratkan oleh ketentuan atau kebutuhan tertentu.

en.question: What is the procedure for converting a CV into a PT?
en.answer: Settle the CV's engagements with third parties; amend the CV's Articles of Association, since a CV's Articles do not regulate Authorized, Issued, and Paid-up Capital, whereas a PT must meet the PT capital requirements (see Article 7 [2] of the Company Law), and every CV partner who will become a PT founder must take up shares when the PT is established; execute a notarial deed of establishment containing the Articles of Association and other particulars (see Article 7 [1] jo. Article 8 [1]); the founders jointly submit the legal-entity approval application electronically via AHU Online (see Article 1 [16] jo. Article 9 [1]); publish the establishment in the State Gazette Supplement. If the founders wish to carry over legal acts performed while still a CV into the new PT so those acts bind the newly established PT, the first General Meeting of Shareholders (GMS) must expressly state that it accepts/assumes all rights and obligations arising from acts performed by the prospective founders or their representatives (see Article 13 [1]).

en.question: How much capital is required to establish a PT, both Authorized Capital and Issued/Paid-up Capital?
en.answer: Under Government Regulation No. 8 of 2021, Article 3, for businesses meeting the micro and small criteria, the amount of authorized capital is determined by the founders' own decision. Under Article 4, that authorized capital must be issued and fully paid up at least 25%, evidenced by proof of payment, and must be reported electronically to the Minister within 60 days at the latest from the date of the deed of establishment.

en.question: What are the requirements to become a PT shareholder?
en.answer: An individual or legal entity capable of performing legal acts, holding a Tax ID (NPWP), and being an Indonesian citizen (WNI).

en.question: Can a foreign citizen or foreign legal entity become a shareholder of an Indonesian PT?
en.answer: Yes. Foreign ownership causes the company to be classified as a foreign investment company (PT PMA) and it must comply with foreign investment regulations.

en.question: What is the procedure for changing a PT's purposes and objectives?
en.answer: Carried out through a General Meeting of Shareholders, set out in a notarial deed, then submitted as an amendment to the Articles of Association via AHU Online to obtain the Minister's approval.

en.question: What should be done if one of an Indonesian PT's shareholders is a foreign legal entity that has been dissolved without the PT's knowledge?
en.answer: The PT needs to trace the legal status of that shareholder, then carry out a change of shareholders by bringing in a representative of the dissolved foreign legal entity to transfer its shares to another legal entity or an individual.

en.question: What is the difference between acquisition, share transfer, and merger?
en.answer: A merger (Article 1 [9] of the Company Law) is a legal act by one or more companies to merge into another existing company, causing the merging company's assets and liabilities to transfer by operation of law and its legal-entity status to end. An acquisition (Article 1 [11]) is a legal act to take over a company's shares resulting in a transfer of control, but the acquired company's legal-entity status does not end. In a merger, only the surviving/acquiring company continues to exist; in an acquisition, both companies continue to exist.

en.question: What are the procedures and requirements for Stage II dissolution of a PT?
en.answer: A letter on the results of the company's liquidation from the liquidator addressed to the Ministry of Law and Human Rights, attn. Director of Civil Affairs of the AHU Directorate General, together with details of the distribution of the company's remaining assets/balance sheet; a copy of the notarial deed on the termination of legal-entity status and notice of the discharge/settlement of the liquidator's liability; the original newspaper announcement of the final results of the liquidation process (Article 152 [3] of Law No. 40 of 2007); the original proof of non-tax state revenue (PNBP) payment of Rp30,000 for the State Gazette announcement of the asset distribution, paid into the account of Perum Percetakan Negara RI; and a Notary's application letter sent manually (by post) to the AHU Directorate General, Legal Entity (PT) Subdirectorate.

en.question: What are the next steps after a PT completes its dissolution?
en.answer: The next step is the termination of the company's legal-entity status and announcing that termination in the State Gazette of the Republic of Indonesia, so that the PT is also released from tax obligations.

en.question: What is the procedure for applying for the dissolution of a PT that has already been dissolved due to bankruptcy or insolvency based on a Commercial Court ruling?
en.answer: The dissolution procedure is governed by Minister of Law and Human Rights Regulation No. 1 of 2016 amending Regulation No. 4 of 2014. The dissolution application is submitted by a Notary electronically through the Legal Entity Administration System (SABH/AHU Online). After the District Court's ruling, the liquidator contacts a Notary to draw up the Deed of Dissolution, then must publish an announcement in the print media. Within 30 days, proof of the newspaper announcement and the online notification letter (issued 2 months after the announcement), together with proof of the Rp30,000 PNBP payment, must be attached. After 60 days, the liquidator carries out the asset settlement and asks the Notary to draw up the Settlement Deed. There are 2 stages: (1) via AHU Online — drawing up the dissolution deed, accessing the online system, a 30-day period, then waiting 60 days from the newspaper announcement to print the Notice of Receipt of Dissolution Notification; (2) by the Liquidator/Notary manually — settling the assets (using an appraisal), publishing the settlement announcement in a newspaper, drawing up the Settlement Deed with a Notary, and manually reporting the final settlement results to the Ministry, followed by the announcement of the termination of the PT's legal-entity status.

en.question: What is the procedure for applying to correct incorrect PT data?
en.answer: Submitted by a Notary through AHU Online with supporting documents proving the data error. Company data correction can be done in 2 ways: (1) the online system, if the Decree/Approval Letter (SK/SP) is no more than 90 days old — corrections that can be done online include NIK/passport number, Tax ID (NPWP), and position if it already matches the deed; (2) the manual system, if it has been more than 90 days since the SK/SP was issued, with the following requirements: an application letter for database entry correction addressed to the AHU Directorate General, attn. Directorate of Civil Affairs c.q. Legal Entity Subdirectorate of the Ministry of Law and Human Rights (Jl. HR. Rasuna Said Kav. 6-7, Kuningan, South Jakarta 12940), a notarized statement letter from the Notary, and supporting data such as a copy of the ID card/Tax ID/passport, a legalized copy of the deed (if correcting capital), a copy of the latest SK/SP amendment, and the PNBP payment for the data entry correction.

en.question: What company data can be corrected?
en.answer: Administrative data resulting from input or writing errors, supported by valid documents, including: personal data of the Shareholders and the company's Management (place of birth, country of origin, passport/national ID number, date of birth, address, Tax ID, position, and nominal share value); Authorized Capital and Issued/Paid-up Capital; the company's domicile/full address; the email address and phone number of the Management and Shareholders; and the deed number and date.

en.question: What is the substantive verification process?
en.answer: An examination by AHU officers of the conformity of the documents and the substance of the application with applicable legal provisions, covering applications for changes to company data, changes to the composition of Directors and Commissioners, and share transfers.

en.question: How long does the Substantive Verification process take?
en.answer: It depends on the complexity and completeness of the documents as well as the queue of applications being processed by AHU. Based on official announcements shared on AHU's official social media, the Substantive Verification process takes approximately 14 working days.

en.question: What is the procedure for fulfilling a PT's Annual Report obligation?
en.answer: The annual report is prepared by the board of directors, reviewed by the board of commissioners, approved at a General Meeting of Shareholders, and set out in a Notarial Deed no later than 6 months after the close of the preceding financial year, then reported to the Minister no later than 30 days after the GMS is notarized.

en.question: Is a CV required to file an annual report like a PT?
en.answer: No. There is no obligation to file an annual report with AHU as applies to a Limited Liability Company (PT).

en.question: What is the procedure for reporting a Beneficial Owner (BO)?
en.answer: This can be done when the business entity is established, through the Corporate Beneficial Owner application, handled separately by the Notary who draws up and reports the Deed of Establishment.

en.question: What is the difference between Updating and Changing a Beneficial Owner?
en.answer: Both Change and Update can only be done if there has already been a prior report. The Change feature allows adding and deleting existing data. The Update feature allows updating/editing data. All data can be changed except the beneficial owner's name, place, and date of birth — if there is an error in that data or the applicant wants to change the name, place, or date of birth, the applicant must choose the Change transaction.

en.question: What are the criteria for a company's Beneficial Owner?
en.answer: The Beneficial Owner of a limited liability company is an individual who meets one of the following criteria: holds more than 25% of the shares as stated in the Articles of Association; holds more than 25% of the voting rights as stated in the Articles of Association; receives more than 25% of the company's profits per year; has the authority to appoint, replace, or dismiss members of the board of directors and board of commissioners; has the authority or power to influence or control the company without needing authorization from any party; receives benefits from the company; and/or is the true owner of the funds behind the company's share ownership.

en.question: What documents can be apostilled?
en.answer: Not all documents require an apostille; it depends on the requirements of the destination country. Documents that can be apostilled include Birth Certificates, Diplomas, Marriage Documents (Marriage Certificate/Book), and Company Documents.

en.question: Does an Apostille certificate have a validity period (does it expire)?
en.answer: An Apostille certificate in principle has no validity period of its own, but the document it is attached to may have a validity period according to the provisions applicable to that particular document (for example, a Police Clearance Certificate).

en.question: What is the difference between a Sole Proprietorship Company (Perseroan Perorangan), a Limited Liability Company (PT), and a Limited Partnership (CV)?
en.answer: A Sole Proprietorship Company is established by one person for micro and small businesses. A PT is established by two or more people as an association of capital. A CV is not a legal entity and consists of active and passive (silent) partners.

en.question: What documents can be used as fiduciary collateral?
en.answer: Tangible and intangible movable objects, receivables, inventory, vehicles, machinery, and other assets that meet the requirements to be a fiduciary object.

en.question: What are the requirements for registering a will?
en.answer: Carried out by a Notary by submitting the will's data and documents in accordance with applicable provisions through the AHU system.

en.question: What are the requirements and procedure for revoking a will?
en.answer: Submitted by a Notary based on a revocation deed or the document forming the basis for the revocation, then reported through AHU.

en.question: What are the requirements for establishing a Foundation (Yayasan) that was founded before the Foundation Law?
en.answer: For a Foundation that came into being before the Law and does not meet the requirements of Article 71 of the Law, that Foundation must obtain approval of its establishment by stating its history in the preamble in accordance with Article 15a of Government Regulation No. 2 of 2013, after first reserving a name.

en.question: What happens if a Foundation's Management Board (Pengurus) has a vacancy?
en.answer: The Board of Trustees (Pembina) must immediately appoint a new member of the Management Board in accordance with the mechanism set out in the Foundation's Articles of Association.

en.question: What matters underlie the need to close/dissolve a Foundation?
en.answer: Because the Foundation's purpose has been achieved or cannot be achieved, its term has ended, there is a court ruling, or other reasons in accordance with the law.

en.question: How do you register a CV that was established before the Law but has not yet been registered with the court?
en.answer: Under Minister of Law and Human Rights Regulation No. 17 of 2018 on the Registration of Limited Partnerships, General Partnerships, and Civil Partnerships, CV registration must be done through a Notary by accessing the Business Entity Administration System (SABU) service menu on AHU Online. The general requirements for establishing a CV: the founders must consist of at least 2 people, referred to as Active and Passive/Silent Partners; the notarial deed must be in the Indonesian language; the CV's founders must be Indonesian citizens. The applicant must draw up a new deed whose preamble mentions the existing deed of establishment, and that deed is then registered with the AHU Directorate General.

en.question: Is it necessary to use a newspaper announcement when dissolving a CV?
en.answer: There is no general obligation for a newspaper announcement as applies to the dissolution of a PT, unless required by specific provisions or particular needs.

zh.question: 将CV（两合公司）转换为PT（有限责任公司）的程序是什么？
zh.answer: 结清CV与第三方的往来债务;修改CV的章程——因为CV的章程中没有关于法定资本、认购资本和实缴资本的规定，而成为PT必须符合PT法定资本的规定（见《公司法》第7条第[2]款），且每一位将成为PT发起人的CV合伙人都必须在PT设立时认购股份;制作载有章程及其他与PT设立相关说明的设立契据（公证契据）（见第7条第[1]款及第8条第[1]款）;各发起人共同通过AHU Online以电子方式提交法人资格核准申请（见第1条第16项及第9条第[1]款）;在国家公报增刊上公告设立。若发起人希望将CV阶段发生的法律行为纳入新设立的PT并使该行为对新设立的PT具有约束力，首次股东大会必须明确表示接受/承接由准发起人或其代理人所作法律行为产生的一切权利和义务（见第13条第[1]款）。

zh.question: 设立PT所需的资本（法定资本以及认购/实缴资本）分别是多少？
zh.answer: 根据2021年第8号政府条例第3条，符合微小企业标准的企业，其法定资本额度由发起人自行决定。根据第4条，该法定资本必须至少认购并实缴25%，并以缴款证明为凭，且须在设立契据签署之日起最迟60天内以电子方式向部长报告。

zh.question: 成为PT股东的条件是什么？
zh.answer: 具备完全民事行为能力的自然人或法人，持有纳税人识别号（NPWP），并且是印度尼西亚公民（WNI）。

zh.question: 外国公民或外国法人可以成为印尼PT的股东吗？
zh.answer: 可以。外资持股将使该公司成为外商投资公司（PT PMA），并须遵守外商投资相关规定。

zh.question: 变更PT经营范围及目的的程序是什么？
zh.answer: 须通过股东大会决议，并制成公证契据，随后通过AHU Online提交章程变更申请，以获得部长批准。

zh.question: 如果印尼PT的其中一名股东是外国法人，且该外国法人已解散而PT并不知情，应如何处理？
zh.answer: PT需要追查该股东的法律状态，随后通过引入该已解散外国法人的代表办理股东变更，将其股份转让给其他法人或个人。

zh.question: 收购、股权转让与合并之间有何区别？
zh.answer: 合并（《公司法》第1条第[9]款）是指一家或多家公司与另一家现有公司合并，从而使合并公司的资产和负债依法转移给接受合并的公司，合并公司的法人资格因此终止。收购（第1条第[11]款）是指法人或个人接管公司股份从而导致公司控制权转移的法律行为，但被收购公司的法人资格并不终止。合并中，只有接受合并的公司继续存在;收购中，两家公司均继续存在。

zh.question: PT第二阶段解散的程序和要求有哪些？
zh.answer: 清算人出具的公司清算结果函，致法律与人权部民事总局，并附带公司剩余财产分配明细/资产负债表;法人资格终止的公证书副本以及清算人责任解除/清偿的通知书;依据2007年第40号公司法第152条第[3]款关于清算最终结果的原始报纸公告;向国家印刷公司账户缴纳的30,000印尼盾国家公报公告非税收入（PNBP）原始缴款凭证;以及以邮寄方式人工提交至法律与人权部民事总局法人（PT）分局的公证人申请函。

zh.question: PT完成解散后的下一步是什么？
zh.answer: 下一步是公司法人资格正式终止，并在印度尼西亚共和国国家公报上公告该终止事项，以使该PT同时免除纳税义务。

zh.question: 根据商事法院裁定因破产或资不抵债而已解散的PT，申请解散的程序是什么？
zh.answer: 解散程序依据2016年第1号法律与人权部长条例（修订2014年第4号条例）执行。解散申请由公证人通过法人行政管理系统（SABH/AHU Online）以电子方式提交。地方法院裁定作出后，清算人须联系公证人制作解散契据，并须在印刷媒体上刊登公告。30天内，须附上报纸公告证明及线上通知函（于公告后2个月发出）以及30,000印尼盾PNBP缴款凭证。60天后，清算人进行财产清理，并请公证人制作清理契据。共分两个阶段：（1）通过AHU Online——制作解散契据、进入线上系统、期限30天，随后等待报纸公告后60天以打印解散通知受理函;（2）由清算人/公证人以人工方式办理——进行财产清理（使用评估）、在报纸上刊登清理公告、由公证人制作清理契据，并以人工方式向部里报告最终清理结果，随后公告PT法人资格终止。

zh.question: 申请更正错误的PT数据的程序是什么？
zh.answer: 由公证人通过AHU Online提交，并附上证明数据错误的支持文件。公司数据更正可通过两种方式进行：（1）线上系统——若批准函/决定书（SK/SP）签发未超过90天，可在线更正的项目包括身份证号/护照号、纳税人识别号（NPWP），以及若已与契据一致的职位;（2）人工系统——若SK/SP签发已超过90天，所需材料包括：致法律与人权部民事总局法人分局的数据库更正申请函（地址：Jl. HR. Rasuna Said Kav. 6-7, Kuningan, 南雅加达 12940）、公证人出具的附印花税声明书，以及支持数据，如身份证/NPWP/护照复印件、（若更正资本）经认证的契据复印件、最新变更SK/SP复印件，以及数据更正PNBP缴款凭证。

zh.question: 哪些公司数据可以更正？
zh.answer: 因录入或书写错误且有合法文件支持的行政数据，包括：股东及公司管理层（董事/监事）的个人数据（出生地、原籍国、护照/身份证号、出生日期、地址、NPWP、职位以及股份名义价值）;法定资本及认购/实缴资本;公司住所/详细地址;管理层及股东的电子邮箱和电话号码;以及契据编号和日期。

zh.question: 什么是实质性核验流程？
zh.answer: 由AHU官员对文件及申请实质内容与现行法律规定的符合性进行审查，涉及范围包括公司数据变更申请、董事及监事组成变更，以及股权转让。

zh.question: 实质性核验流程需要多长时间？
zh.answer: 取决于文件的复杂程度和完整性，以及AHU正在处理的申请排队情况。根据AHU官方社交媒体发布的公告，实质性核验流程大约需要14个工作日。

zh.question: 履行PT年度报告义务的程序是什么？
zh.answer: 年度报告由董事会编制，由监事会审核，在股东大会上批准，并须在上一财政年度结束后最迟6个月内制成公证契据，随后在股东大会公证后最迟30天内向部长报告。

zh.question: CV是否也必须像PT一样提交年度报告？
zh.answer: 不需要。CV没有像有限责任公司（PT）那样向AHU提交年度报告的义务。

zh.question: 申报实际受益人（BO）的程序是什么？
zh.answer: 可以在企业设立时通过公司实益所有人（BO）应用程序进行申报，由制作并申报设立契据的公证人另行单独办理。

zh.question: 更新（Pengkinian）和变更（Perubahan）实益所有人有何区别？
zh.answer: 变更和更新只能在此前已有申报记录的情况下进行。变更功能可以新增和删除现有数据。更新功能可以对数据进行更新/编辑。除实益所有人的姓名、出生地和出生日期外，所有数据均可修改——若该部分数据有误或申请人希望更改姓名、出生地或出生日期，申请人必须选择变更交易。

zh.question: 公司实益所有人的认定标准有哪些？
zh.answer: 有限责任公司的实益所有人是指符合以下任一标准的自然人：持有超过25%的股份（章程中列明）;拥有超过25%的表决权（章程中列明）;每年获得公司超过25%的利润;有权任命、更换或解任董事会及监事会成员;无需任何一方授权即有权力或能力影响或控制公司;从公司获得利益;及/或是公司股份背后资金的实际所有者。

zh.question: 哪些文件可以办理海牙认证（Apostille）？
zh.answer: 并非所有文件都需要办理海牙认证，具体取决于目的地国家的要求。可办理海牙认证的文件包括出生证明、学历证书、婚姻文件（结婚证/结婚证书），以及公司文件。

zh.question: 海牙认证证书是否有有效期（会过期吗）？
zh.answer: 海牙认证证书本身原则上没有独立的有效期，但其所附着的文件可能依据该文件各自的规定而有相应的有效期（例如：警察无犯罪记录证明）。

zh.question: 个人独资有限公司（Perseroan Perorangan）与有限责任公司（PT）以及两合公司（CV）之间有何区别？
zh.answer: 个人独资有限公司由一人设立，适用于微小企业。PT由两人或以上作为资本联合体设立。CV不具有法人资格，由积极合伙人和消极（隐名）合伙人组成。

zh.question: 哪些文件可以作为信托担保（Fidusia）的标的物？
zh.answer: 有形和无形的动产、应收账款、存货、车辆、机械，以及符合信托担保标的物条件的其他资产。

zh.question: 登记遗嘱的要求有哪些？
zh.answer: 由公证人办理，通过AHU系统按照现行规定提交遗嘱相关数据及文件。

zh.question: 撤销遗嘱的条件和程序是什么？
zh.answer: 由公证人根据撤销契据或作为撤销依据的文件提出申请，随后通过AHU进行报告。

zh.question: 在《基金会法》颁布之前设立的基金会（Yayasan），其设立要求是什么？
zh.answer: 对于在该法律颁布之前成立、且不符合该法律第71条要求的基金会，该基金会必须依据2013年第2号政府条例第15a条的规定，在设立核准的前言中说明其历史沿革，并事先办理名称预订。

zh.question: 如果基金会的管理机构（Pengurus）出现空缺，会怎样？
zh.answer: 监察人（Pembina）必须依照基金会章程规定的机制，立即任命新的管理机构成员。

zh.question: 需要关闭/解散基金会的依据有哪些？
zh.answer: 因基金会的宗旨已经实现或无法实现、存续期限已届满、存在法院裁定，或依法律规定的其他原因。

zh.question: 如何为在该法律颁布之前成立但尚未在法院登记的CV办理登记？
zh.answer: 根据2018年第17号法律与人权部长条例关于两合公司、普通合伙及民事合伙登记的规定，CV的登记必须通过公证人在AHU Online上访问企业行政管理系统（SABU）服务菜单办理。设立CV的一般要求：发起人至少由2人组成，分别称为积极合伙人和消极（隐名）合伙人;公证契据须以印尼语制作;CV的发起人必须为印尼公民。申请人须制作一份新契据，其前言中提及已存在的设立契据，随后将该契据向AHU总局登记。

zh.question: 解散CV时是否需要刊登报纸公告？
zh.answer: 与解散PT不同，解散CV并无普遍的报纸公告义务，除非特定规定或特殊需要另有要求。
